fact: The 2025/2026 development plan put to the House of Representatives on 16 April 2025 allocates EGP 13 billion of public investment to ICT, EGP 9 billion of it from the state budget, and lists a secure, closed government network and connectivity upgrades across administrative institutions among its priority projects; local units are not named.
title: H.E. Dr. Rania Al-Mashat Presents 2025/2026 Development Targets for Egypt’s Communications & Information Technology Sector Before the House of Representatives
publisher: Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation
